  | n+1, m => plus3821 n m + 1

theorem plus3821_zero_right (n : Nat) : plus3821 n 0 = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus3821, ih]

theorem plus3821_succ_right (n m : Nat) : plus3821 n (m+1) = plus3821 n m + 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp [plus3821, ih]
theorem plus3821_comm (n m : Nat) : plus3821 n m = plus3821 m n :=
A: by
  induction n generalizing m with
  | zero => simp [plus3821, plus3821_zero_right]
  | succ k ih => simp [plus3821, ih, plus3821_succ_right]
